outcome: Composite measure of maternal interventions/adverse outcomes
Adverse perinatal outcome (neonatal unit admission or perinatal death)
cohort: 63,371 women aged over 16 without known medical or obstetric risk factors, with singleton pregnancies, planning vaginal birth
finding: Interventions and adverse maternal outcomes requiring obstetric care generally increased with age, particularly in nulliparous women, with the relationship differing by planned place of birth.
